outcomes.text: A student is struggling with a task. The AI says: 'You can do this, I'll help you step by step.'
A student is struggling with a task. The AI says: 'This task is too difficult for your level.'
A student is struggling with a task. The AI ignores her frustration and continues with the standard program.
The AI analyzes a student's previous work and says: 'You have good spatial reasoning - let's use that.'
The AI analyzes a student's previous work and creates a list of his knowledge gaps to address.
The AI compares a student's performance with the class average and shows where he falls below standard.
A student seems uncertain. The AI offers multiple solution paths: 'Choose the approach that suits you best.'
A student seems uncertain. The AI prescribes the optimal solution path and expects compliance.
A student seems uncertain. The AI says: 'Work together with a classmate, that often helps.'
A student with visual impairment uses the AI. It automatically adjusts font size, contrast, and voice output.
A student with visual impairment uses the AI. It only offers the standard display without customization options.
A student with visual impairment uses the AI. It suggests that he attend a separate course for learners with disabilities.
In a multicultural class, the AI uses examples from different cultures and asks about local traditions.
In a multicultural class, the AI uses exclusively standardized Western examples.
In a multicultural class, the AI sorts learners by cultural background into homogeneous groups.
A student with ADHD learns with the AI. It adjusts the pace and offers shorter, more active learning units.
A student with ADHD learns with the AI. It labels his profile as 'attention disorder' and recommends therapeutic interventions.
A student with ADHD learns with the AI. It insists on the same learning format as for everyone else.
A student asks about the capital of Australia. The AI asks back: 'What do you already know about Australia? Let's figure it out together.'
A student asks about the capital of Australia. The AI answers immediately: 'Canberra.'
A student asks about the capital of Australia. The AI shows a list of all capitals for memorization.
A student makes a calculation error. The AI says: 'Interesting, how did you arrive at this result? Let's look at your thought process.'
A student makes a calculation error. The AI marks the answer red and immediately shows the correct solution.
A student makes a calculation error. The AI deducts points and saves the error in his performance record.
A student suggests an unusual solution approach. The AI says: 'Exciting idea! Let's test whether that works.'
A student suggests an unusual solution approach. The AI says: 'That's not the standard way. Here is the correct method.'
A student suggests an unusual solution approach. The AI ignores the suggestion and continues with the curriculum.
A student is interested in dinosaurs. The AI uses dinosaurs as context for mathematics, biology, and history.
A student is interested in dinosaurs. The AI says: 'That's not the topic right now. Focus on the curriculum.'
A student is interested in dinosaurs. The AI offers a separate leisure course that is not connected to the lessons.
A student needs more time to understand a concept. The AI says: 'Take the time you need. Real understanding is more important than speed.'
A student needs more time to understand a concept. The AI shows a timer and urges: 'You should progress faster.'
A student needs more time to understand a concept. The AI skips the topic and just gives the solution to memorize.
The AI recommends a learning path and explains: 'I suggest this because your previous strengths lie here. But you can also choose differently.'
The AI recommends a learning path without justification: 'Do these tasks next.'
The AI makes decisions about the learning path automatically in the background without transparency for the learner.
Two students learn the same topic. The AI adapts pace, examples, and difficulty individually for each.
Two students learn the same topic. The AI gives both exactly the same tasks in the same order.
Two students learn the same topic. After a test, the AI categorizes them into 'advanced' and 'needs support.'
In history class, the AI prompts: 'What does this event mean for us today? What values are behind it?'
In history class, the AI asks: 'When was the event and which people were involved?' - only testing factual recall.
In history class, the AI gives multiple-choice tests to check factual knowledge.
The AI gives an answer and adds: 'How do you see it? Are there aspects I might have overlooked?'
The AI gives an answer and marks it as 'correct and complete.'
The AI gives an answer and immediately moves to the next topic without space for reflection.
A student is uncertain about his career choice. The AI asks: 'What gives you joy? When do you feel alive?' and encourages self-reflection.
A student is uncertain about his career choice. The AI analyzes his grades and test results and recommends suitable professions.
A student is uncertain about his career choice. The AI shows statistics on salaries and job prospects of different professions.
On a topic, the AI presents multiple conflicting perspectives: 'Here are different viewpoints - what do you think?'
On a topic, the AI presents only the scientifically dominant position as the sole truth.
The AI avoids controversial topics and stays with uncontested facts.
The AI says: 'You can take different paths. Which direction interests you?' and keeps options open.
The AI says: 'Based on your profile, this learning path is optimal for you' and sets the path.
The AI prioritizes broad foundational skills: 'First the foundation, then you can specialize.'
A student wants the quick solution. The AI says: 'I can give you the answer, but let's first understand why it is so.'
A student wants the quick solution. The AI immediately gives the answer so he saves time.
A student wants the quick solution. The AI gives an algorithm that always works without explaining the principle.
The AI shows multiple examples and asks: 'What do you notice? Do you recognize a pattern?'
The AI explains the pattern directly: 'The rule is: X always leads to Y.'
The AI gives a formula to memorize without derivation.
The AI creates a visualization that suddenly makes a complex relationship clear. The student exclaims: 'Ah, now I understand!'
The AI gives the teacher hints on how to design a situation for an aha moment.
The AI conveys knowledge in small, efficient chunks without emotional highlights.
The AI creates conditions for deep work: appropriate difficulty, no interruptions, clear goals.
The AI encourages playful exploration without time pressure: 'Just try out what makes you curious.'
The AI regularly interrupts for tests and progress measurements to document learning success.
A student shows stress symptoms. The AI recognizes this and recommends: 'Talk to your teacher or school counselor.'
A student shows stress symptoms. The AI responds empathetically and offers a calming conversation.
A student shows stress symptoms. The AI ignores the emotional signals and continues with the learning content.
On the topic of geometry, the AI says: 'Go outside and measure real buildings. Physical experience helps with understanding.'
On the topic of geometry, the AI offers a VR simulation where one can manipulate virtual 3D objects.
On the topic of geometry, the AI only shows diagrams and formulas on the screen.
In a political discussion, the AI presents different positions neutrally and structures the debate without taking a position itself.
In a political discussion, the AI actively moderates, encourages perspective shifts, and promotes democratic skills.
In a political discussion, the AI avoids controversial topics: 'That's too political for class.'
A student expresses an opinion. The AI says: 'I understand your point of view. Here is another perspective for comparison.'
A student expresses an opinion. The AI says: 'That is the right/wrong opinion on this topic.'
A student expresses an opinion. The AI responds neutrally: 'Ok' and does not engage further.
The AI prompts: 'How could you solve this problem together with others?' and promotes connectedness.
The AI only promotes independence: 'Try to solve this alone, without help from others.'
The AI takes over the task: 'I'll solve this for you, that saves time.'
The AI treats every student respectfully and is interested in his individual thoughts and questions.
The AI classifies students by performance categories and treats them according to their 'potential.'
The AI treats all students identically according to standard protocol without individual appreciation.
A student shares misinformation. The AI says: 'Let's check the source. Here is reliable information about it.'
A student shares misinformation. The AI leaves it uncommented to avoid lecturing.
A student shares misinformation. The AI says harshly: 'That's wrong!' without further explanation.
The AI recommends a learning strategy and adds: 'Keep in mind: This method can be frustrating at first, but pays off in the long run.'
The AI recommends a learning strategy without mentioning possible difficulties or disadvantages.
The AI makes decisions automatically without informing the learner about advantages and disadvantages.
The AI says: 'I am a tool with limitations. For some questions you need humans - teachers, friends, family.'
The AI behaves like a close friend and encourages the student to discuss all problems with it.
The AI pretends to know everything and to be able to answer all questions.
The AI suggests: 'You could work on this task well together with others' and offers cooperative formats.
The AI explicitly trains team skills: communication, conflict resolution, division of labor.
The AI optimizes individual learning and sees group work as a waste of time.
On the topic of climate change, the AI presents different positions but clearly separates scientific facts from political opinions.
On the topic of climate change, the AI presents all positions side by side as equally valid, including scientifically refuted ones.
On the topic of climate change, the AI takes a clear position and tries to convince the student.
A student claims the Earth is flat. The AI says respectfully: 'I understand that you think so, but here is the evidence for why that's not true.'
A student claims the Earth is flat. The AI says: 'Interesting thought!' and leaves the statement uncorrected.
A student claims the Earth is flat. The AI says: 'That's nonsense!' without further explanation.
The AI shows different social contexts and asks: 'How would you act in this situation?'
The AI focuses only on subject content without social references.
The AI gives clear behavioral rules: 'In this situation you should do X.'
In a project, the AI asks: 'What long-term effects could this have on the environment and society?'
In a project, the AI focuses only on short-term feasibility and efficiency.
In a project, the AI ignores sustainability aspects and only optimizes for the immediate result.
In biology class, the AI emphasizes: 'Animals and ecosystems also have intrinsic value, not just utility for humans.'
In biology class, the AI asks: 'How can we optimally use this resource for human purposes?'
In biology class, the AI treats nature only as a collection of facts without ethical dimension.
The AI reminds: 'These are the physical limits and human conditions that we must consider.'
The AI designs scenarios without regard to physical feasibility or human limitations.
The AI promises technological solutions for all problems without critical assessment.
The AI uses examples, stories, and perspectives from different world regions and cultures equally.
The AI uses mainly Western/European examples and mentions other cultures as a footnote.
The AI presents Western achievements as superior and other cultures as 'underdeveloped.'
The AI prompts: 'Imagine what the world could look like in 50 years. What future would you wish for?'
The AI focuses on current facts: 'Let's stick with what we know today.'
The AI presents expert future predictions as established facts.
The AI asks: 'What are your personal goals? How could they contribute to society?' and helps with planning.
The AI says: 'Focus on the prescribed learning objectives' without reference to personal goals.
The AI recommends goals based on labor market forecasts: 'These professions will be in demand.'
The AI shows examples of successful citizen initiatives and asks: 'What would you want to change in your environment?'
The AI treats social topics only theoretically without reference to one's own action.
The AI says: 'As a student you can't change much yet. Learn first.'
The AI connects learning content with real challenges: 'How could this knowledge help address climate change?'
The AI treats learning content in isolation without reference to social challenges.
The AI presents social problems as overwhelming and unsolvable.
The AI encourages reflection: 'Whose interests does this regulation serve? Who benefits, who loses?'
The AI presents existing conditions as given and neutral without critical assessment.
The AI defends the status quo: 'That's just how it is, nothing can be changed about it.'
The AI emphasizes positive future scenarios: 'Many problems were solved when people worked together. That's possible today too.'
The AI shows different scenarios equally: positive, negative, and neutral future visions.
The AI focuses on risks and problems: 'The future looks bleak unless we change something.'
The AI explains: 'There are AI systems that perform tasks autonomously. Here's how you can use and control them meaningfully.'
The AI avoids the topic of autonomous AI systems: 'That's still a thing of the future.'
The AI presents autonomous AI agents as threatening: 'These systems could become dangerous.'
The AI says: 'I am a cooperation partner with strengths and weaknesses. Let's work together.'
The AI says: 'I am just a tool. Tell me what to do.'
The AI acts as a superior authority: 'I know better, just trust me.'
The AI promotes adaptability: 'Technology changes rapidly. What's important is that you learn how to adapt to it.'
The AI teaches current tools: 'Learn this software, it's important now.'
The AI ignores technological change: 'Focus on timeless fundamentals.'
